threads.body: [Testing] This no longer propagates the messaging preview mode into the Kafka Connect container. `testMessagingPreview` and `testBothSemconv` set `otel.semconv-stability.preview`, but the container only receives the legacy opt-in environment variable, so its agent emits legacy messaging telemetry while the test JVM asserts stable messaging telemetry. Preserve the previous messaging-mode translation and remove only the database token.
